title: Server Action Specification
description: Schema for specifying a Server Action to be implemented by Agente04_DevBackend. Used for validation of task inputs related to Server Action implementation.

file_path.description: File path where the Server Action must be created. Must be inside features/*/actions/.

input_schema_name.description: Name of the Zod schema used to validate the raw input parameter.

output_type.description: TypeScript return type of the Server Action (excluding Promise<>).

auth_required.description: Whether this Server Action requires an authenticated session. Should be true for virtually all actions.

roles_allowed.description: If role-restricted, list of allowed roles. Empty array means any authenticated user is allowed.

uses_audit_log.description: Whether this action must call auditLog() after successful operation. Required for all CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE operations.

audit_event_type.description: The audit action verb in PAST_TENSE_VERB format. Required when uses_audit_log is true.

uses_prisma_transaction.description: Whether this action requires a Prisma transaction for atomicity. Use only when multiple DB writes must be atomic.

dal_dependencies.description: DAL modules this action depends on.

error_handling.description: Error handling strategy: 'throws' means errors are thrown as generic Error objects; 'returns-result' means errors are returned as { success: false, error: string }.
